canonicalFacts.claim: Acute gout inflammation is mediated by NLRP3 inflammasome activation leading to IL-1β release
Up to one-third of chronic kidney disease patients have a history of gout

redFlags: Febuxostat may increase cardiovascular mortality compared to allopurinol in patients with cardiovascular disease
Less than 25% of gout patients with chronic kidney disease achieve target serum urate levels
Multiple drug interactions and dosing adjustments required in patients with kidney disease

excludedAgents.name: febuxostat
excludedAgents.reason: showed no benefit over placebo for kidney function preservation in stage 3 CKD patients with asymptomatic hyperuricemia

excludedAgents.name: DKB114
excludedAgents.reason: showed no significant difference from placebo in reducing serum uric acid levels after 6 weeks in patients with asymptomatic hyperuricemia
